meta.name: Stormbreaker Concordance Grimoire
meta.description: Pioneered by The Forge Squad of the Enclave of the 16 during the First Forge, this ledger translates operator focus into sympathetic core-metallurgy. Kept by the Rivet Assayer, reading its hyper-dense passages tames subterranean plasma, permanently increasing the market value of your ores. As a sudden discharge of geomancy upon reading, it transmutes the rock beneath your feet into pure rivet ore if near the surface. Eases market saturation.
meta.author: jules:session
